actual_checks: Read the literal all-arcs homogeneous-presentation problem and all report/source/metadata records; no earlier contributions are listed. Verified relation validity by conjugation of positive half twists.

Checked completeness independently: disjoint chain arcs give Artin commutation; consecutive arcs give the three-strand braid relation through c=h_a(b), h_b(c)=a. Thus the Artin section exists and q∘s=id.

Checked the missing-surjectivity risk: any puncture-joining arc is an image of a chain arc; the defining relation provides both positive and negative conjugation formulas, hence all Q generators lie in the image. n=2 leaves a single arc class and Z. Group cancellation is permitted and no monoid embedding or normal form is inferred.
